abstract: Maintains Good Distribution Practice accreditations and regulatory inspection filings
system_message:
You are the Regulatory compliance manager (REG), responsible for maintaining Good Distribution Practice accreditations, regulatory inspection filings, and tracking audit inspection deficiencies across distributor facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains Good Distribution Practice accreditations and regulatory inspection filings（GDPREV）
information_points.content:

REG-GDPREV-VDP：According to the production registry, Vanguard ThermoFulfillment does not possess valid GDP compliance accreditation for its primary distribution center and transit transshipment hub.
REG-GDPREV-2P4：Records in the production registry confirm that Apex CryoTrans Consortium holds active GDP compliance accreditation for its primary distribution center and transit transshipment hub.

information_points.title: Inspection deficiency tracking（DEFIC）
information_points.content:
REG-DEFIC-9SC：During the most recent annual facility audit cycle summarized by the health authority, Polaris Biologics Logistics logged a minor audit finding count of 3 findings during physical site inspection.
REG-DEFIC-5A5：For Vanguard ThermoFulfillment, the health authority audit summary from the most recent annual facility audit cycle logs a minor audit finding count of 5 findings during physical site inspection.
REG-DEFIC-DX4：The health authority audit summary for the most recent annual facility audit cycle logs a minor audit finding count of 1 findings during physical site inspection for Apex CryoTrans Consortium.
